data.name: A.I. P.I.
data.detailed_description:
A.I. P.I.

( Artificial Intelligence Private Investigator )

A fun and challenging interactive multipath visual novel mystery!

Book 1 - Red Rose Rendezvous

We follow Artie Fiskal and Inga Lance who run a small detective agency to solve crimes.

They discover that one of their clients has been killed, but, when they return with the police, the body has disappeared and a completely different man is at the scene claiming to be the client. This leads the duo to become involved in a CIA investigation, strange clues, international espionage and an assassination plot to kill a very important diplomat at a big event.

But, the problem is that they haven't got any idea who the guy is because, the only description they got is found in a message that says "a man with a red rose on his clothes".

They go to the banquet posing as waiters and trying to solve yet another mystery . . .

. . . and with Your help, the adventure evolves on from there . . .

. . . with more twists and turns than a bag of pretzels!

Gameplay primarily consists of reading/watching the visual novel, with interactive elements, players make choices at certain points, which alter the storyline. Lots of replayability, how many different paths and endings can You find?

Features:

FULLY A.I. Generated TEXT and IMAGES

Interactive Visual Novel

Multipath Options

Choices Matter

Several Different Endings

Main Menu

In-Game Menu

SAVE

LOAD

* NOTE: The TEXT and IMAGES in the game are A.I. Generated. *

* NOTE: Certain parts may be considered "PG-13", and may not be suitable for Younger players, Parental Guidance is advised. *

* This game is entirely a work of fiction.

Any names, organizations, locations, or events appearing in this game are fictitious.

Any resemblance to real names, organizations, locations, events, etc. is purely coincidental.

This game is a work of A.I. and imagination, and above all else, just a game. *

*** Challenges ***

"Easter Egg" Challenge - How many Easter Eggs Appear in the Game ?

"Walkthrough" Challenge - Post a video of a Complete 'Walkthrough' of the entire Game.

"Steamy Streamer" Challenge - Get ALL of the Archor Games products available on Steam and Stream ALL of them.

"IRL ARG" Challenge - This game and some other ARCHOR GAMES are part of an "Alternate Reality Game" "In Real Life" Challenge, be sure to check out ALL of our games for Clues to the Mystery.
